title: Generator Customer Request Form
subtitle: An original generator workflow that preserves the customer's observation and routes a clear service response, with explicit qualified-review, stop-work, escalation, and accountable handoff controls.
description: A workflow-complete generator customer request form for the standby or prime generator system that captures exact identity, domain observations, supporting evidence, decisions, exceptions, responsible owners, and closeout without replacing professional judgment or the organization's controlling procedures.
use_case: Use when a customer asks for service, investigation, or follow-up and staff need a traceable account of the requested outcome, symptoms, evidence, safety screen, communication, and disposition. The generator service coordinator owns routing, and closure requires documented evidence, disposition of restrictions, and acceptance by the designated reviewer.

sections.title: Generator customer request and communication routing
sections.guidance: Capture the customer's own observation and give the request a clear service owner.

sections.title: Generator requested outcome and customer constraints
sections.guidance: Describe the requested result without treating the customer's suspected cause as confirmed.

blocks.label: Customer request type
items: Preventive generator service
Failed exercise or no-start condition
Active alarm or abnormal operation
Battery, charger, fuel, cooling, or leak concern
Transfer-switch or source-status concern
Load-bank, run, or transfer test
Storm, outage, or extended-run readiness
Repair estimate or return-to-service review

blocks.label: Customer observation in their own words

fields.label: What was observed, when it began, frequency, affected service, desired outcome, and prior contact

sections.title: Generator condition timeline and supplied evidence
sections.guidance: Preserve dates, sources, and attachments so service staff can distinguish symptoms from verified findings.

blocks.label: Customer-supplied evidence
items: Photograph or video reference
Bill, usage, or account reference
Display, alarm, or fault wording
Prior ticket or service record
Site plan, equipment document, or product reference
Access instruction, property permission, or appointment detail
Critical-service or accessibility information
No supporting attachment; follow-up owner assigned

sections.title: Generator exceptions, stop conditions, and escalation
sections.guidance: Make every unresolved condition visible with an immediate control, owner, due point, and final disposition.

blocks.label: Stop-condition screen
items: Fuel, oil, coolant, exhaust, or battery leak
Carbon-monoxide alarm, exhaust intrusion, or ventilation failure
Smoke, fire, abnormal heat, burning odor, or electrical arcing
Unexpected start, automatic operation, transfer, or backfeed risk
Exposed moving part, damaged guard, severe vibration, or loose component
Uncontrolled stored electrical, mechanical, thermal, or fluid energy
Critical-load interruption without site and operations authorization
Test or repair beyond the assigned qualified person's scope
blocks.guidance: Check any condition observed or reported; checking an item does not mean the condition is controlled.

blocks.label: Qualified-person and stop-work boundary
blocks.guidance: This form is not a generator energy-control, energized-work, or transfer authorization. Stop for fuel leaks, exhaust or carbon-monoxide concerns, fire, heat, arcing, unexpected start, exposed moving parts, or unknown backfeed. Qualified and authorized personnel must control isolation, test conditions, affected loads, and return to automatic service under current site procedures.

blocks.label: Exception and escalation register
blocks.guidance: Link each customer request exception to supporting evidence and keep it open until disposition is recorded.

sections.title: Generator decision, handoff, and accountable closeout
sections.guidance: Record the decision, remaining limitations, next action, and the people accountable for acceptance.

blocks.label: Closeout completeness
items: Standby or prime generator system identity and location were reconciled
Observed facts, measurements, and evidence references are complete
Decision authority and applicable review requirements were confirmed
Stop conditions, restrictions, and open exceptions remain visible
Customer, operations, or site handoff was recorded
Next action, owner, due point, and record-retention route are explicit

fields.label: Limitations, assumptions, restrictions, customer message, and next-action context

blocks.label: Accountable review and handoff
blocks.guidance: Signatures acknowledge the recorded decision and handoff; they do not waive unresolved restrictions.
